message_creation.description: Constructs protocol messages across payload sizes.

message_serialization.description: Serializes protocol messages to JSON across payload sizes.

transport_send_receive.description: Performs an in-memory transport send/receive round trip.

protocol_start_stop.description: Creates, starts, and stops a protocol instance with a mock BLE transport.

send_message.description: Sends a message through a running protocol instance.

dors_selection.description: Selects a transport with DORS for each message priority.

ble_reassembly.description: Processes all BLE fragments required to reassemble a message.

ble_serialize_1kb.description: Serializes a representative 1 KB message for BLE transport.

telemetry_emit_noop.description: Builds and emits lifecycle telemetry records to a no-op sink.

telemetry_emit_routing_diagnostic.description: Builds and emits a diagnostic routing record with five transport scores.

telemetry_build_metrics_frame.description: Builds the metrics frame paid for on each telemetry cadence interval.
